chapter: Postwar records, Miami and Los Angeles
title: Hollywood visitors at the Club Brazil
summary: Olga San Juan brought Carmen Miranda, Bing Crosby, Rafael Mendez and studio musicians, who marveled at the interpretation.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Now, you say Olga San Juan took part of that.....

Well, Olga San Juan she was so grateful for what happened here , for the Copacabana, whatever, that she was in an opening and really, the place that we was, it wasn't a high-class place, it was a neighborhood place. So Olga, very nice girl, she made her mind to take every person that she know in Hollywood. We had Carmen Miranda, the Dead End Kids, Bing Crosby - Bing Crosby was every night out there.
Mendez, the trumpet player, the famous player...

Rafael Mendez, Manny Klein, all the musicians from the studio. They used to come up here. They was amazed, not amazed technically, because they was the best musicians in the United States in those days. It just our interpretation, they was amazed.
They liked it. Did they dance to it, Machito?
Oh, yes! they went crazy about it. .....
....Pedro Infante, you name it, all the ....
Pedro Infante used to live up there.
... do you remember your last day in Los Angeles, before your return back?
